RenderFormer: How neural networks are reshaping 3D rendering
description: RenderFormer, from Microsoft Research, is the first model to show that a neural network can learn a complete graphics rendering pipeline. It’s designed to support full-featured 3D rendering using only machine learning—no traditional graphics computation required. The post RenderFormer: How neural networks are reshaping 3D rendering appeared first on Microsoft Research .
